package.name: ichava/icon-sets-octicons
package.title: Octicons
package.description: GitHub's Primer icon set at two optical sizes, 16px and 24px. The GitHub logos and product marks are excluded: they are trademarks, not part of the MIT grant.

16px.name: 16px
16px.description: Drawn for a 16 by 16 grid, the size GitHub uses in dense UI

24px.name: 24px
24px.description: Drawn for a 24 by 24 grid, for larger touch targets

source._why_npm: Primer publishes the built SVGs to npm on every release; the repository's icons/ needs a build.

update_command._note: Upstream names files <name>-<size>.svg in one flat directory. The pack keeps <size>px/<name>.svg, so a refresh splits by the size suffix, keeps 16 and 24, and drops the names in upstream.excluded. icon-sets-sync has no transform for that split yet; see pack-recipes/icon-sets-octicons.json in the design folder.

excluded.reason: GitHub logos and product marks are GitHub trademarks; the MIT licence covers the artwork's copyright, not the marks.
excluded._sizes_note: Nine 12px glyphs (chevrons, x, alert-fill and similar) and copilot at 48 and 96 exist upstream; only the 16 and 24 grids are shipped, and copilot is excluded as a mark anyway.
